messages:
julia: Heads-up: there's a docs PR that needs fast review before tomorrow's release cutoff (10:00 PT). PR #4321 updates SDK snippets and adds a migration section for the v2->v3 auth flow. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4321
kevin: on it — I'll review by EOD. quick Q: should this land under /v3.0/ or /latest/? Also is the feature flag `auth.v3_enabled` rolling before cutoff?
samir: flag rollout is scheduled for after cutoff. recommend landing docs under /v3.0-migration/ and add a short banner: "Applies when auth.v3_enabled is enabled". don't expose as latest until the flag is live.
julia: ok. here's the frontmatter snippet to use (add to top of the page):
```
---
version: v3.0-migration
banner: "This guide applies when the auth.v3_enabled feature flag is enabled."
---
```
please add that and push a commit.
docs-ci-bot: link-checker failed for PR 4321 -> /sdk/python/auth.md (broken link to ../examples/token-refresh.md). Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4321/build/5
emily: I can fix the broken link in 15m. Will update example path and run the preview again. @kevin can you re-review after that?
kevin: yep. I found a tiny grammar nits in the migration steps — will push a small commit. plan to merge only after CI green, ideally before 09:30 so we get a steady build before cutoff.
julia: plan: emily fixes links, kevin pushes nits, samir confirms banner copy. I'll merge after CI passes and tag with `release/docs-cutoff-1999854321`. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
